blocks.text: Government Road Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Government Road is a north-east Burnaby corridor south of Lougheed Town Centre, anchored by Seaforth Elementary at 7881 Government Rd.

blocks.text: Government Road Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Houses sit in the R1 SSMUH District: 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 on larger lots, 6 within 400 m of frequent transit; suites count in the total.
The Zoning Bylaw 2026, adopted June 9, 2026, replaced the 1965 bylaw on July 1, 2026.

blocks.text: Government Road Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The original Seaforth School dates to 1922, later moved to Burnaby Village Museum.
Stoney Creek Park has 2 tennis and 2 pickleball courts.

items.t: The Cameron and Burnaby Lake recreation replacements are under construction, due 2028.
TransLink's Burnaby Mountain Gondola, Production Way–University Station to SFU, is not yet approved or funded.

blocks.text: Government Road home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

15 houses sold in Government Road with a median price of $2,380,000 (the middle half sold between $2,087,500 and $2,915,000), taking a median of 39 days to sell at 95.3% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $715 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 10,220 square feet.

faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® counted 24 houses listed in Government Road at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.
faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Government Road?

faq.a: With a sales ratio of 8% in October 2026, houses in Government Road sat in a buyers’ market. The reports read under 12% as a buyers’ market and over 20% as a sellers’ market.
faq.q: Is Government Road a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?

faq.a: Government Road accounted for 7 of the 251 houses sold across Burnaby from June to October 2026.

faq.a: Two elementary schools sit on this corridor. École Seaforth Elementary (K–7) is at 7881 Government Rd, and Stoney Creek Community Elementary (K–7) is at 2740 Beaverbrook Cres.

Yes, an R1 SSMUH lot can hold more homes without rezoning. Burnaby permits three units on lots up to 280 square metres, four on larger lots, and six on larger lots inside a Frequent Transit Network Area. BurnabyMap shows a specific lot's maximum.
faq.q: Can a house lot hold more homes?

faq.a: Metro Vancouver describes Burnaby Lake Regional Park for level trails, wildlife, a dock, and canoeing or kayaking, with dogs leashed and prohibited at Piper Spit, not a swimming beach for houses nearby.

faq.a: A replacement Cameron Community Centre and Library is under construction in Lougheed Town Centre. The City states it will be four times larger than the original, with pools, an expanded library and gym, and gives an estimated completion date of 2028.

faq.q: What did houses in Government Road sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Government Road recorded 15 house sales at a median of $2,380,000.

faq.a: Typical time on the market was 39 days. At the median, sale prices were 95.3% of list, and 0% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
